All nine individual 512px images personally inspected. Single unbranched tapered axis, separate spiral narrow blades, one terminal oval-sporophyll strobilus, integrated four-lobed swollen base and downward rootlets. Clay and rear show no visible coplanar flicker/seam; sparse retained lower leaves are permitted by original scope. Plant component intersections are expected attachments, not grounds for a zero-intersection rule.

finding.note: Primary article sections 2.3.1, 2.3.2, 3.2.1 and actual Figure 1 fossil/Figure 4A reconstruction pixels inspected independently. Exterior P. sternbergii evidence supports an unbranched axis, terminal strobilus, spiral triangular-based linear leaves and rooting base. Rejected P. jiaochengensis short-awn lead is not used to assert long-leaf anatomy. Internal anatomy is excluded; leaf retention, exact root count, proportions and color remain illustrative, not an exact specimen cast.

All nine individual 512px images personally inspected. Four transverse deep V-shaped valleys have unequal spacing and varying paths; coherent solid basal ice. Broad flat margins/end faces are explicitly artificial module cuts, not natural glacier fronts. Clay shows real wall depth. No exposed coplanar overlap observed.

finding.note: Primary NPS text and actual paired photo inspected; V-shaped brittle upper-ice fractures over continuous lower ice support generic morphology. No named-site survey or real crack-depth measurement claimed.

All nine individual 512px images personally inspected. One open central vent, uneven asymmetric rim, welded lobate midwall relief and continuous broad foot. Clay and reverse views show fused geometry rather than disconnected beads. Surface is deliberately simplified, not a site replica. Independent source scan reports zero nonadjacent BVH overlaps and zero non-two-face edges; no hidden stacked shells found.

finding.note: Primary NPS text and Jacob W Frank photograph inspected. Hot near-vent clasts adhere into a cohesive mound; retained fused relief and vent support the generic cooled form. No named eruption, age, magma chamber or site survey claimed.

All nine individual 512px images personally inspected. Five broad, unequal shallow pool levels, scalloped carbonate lips, small saddles and continuous substrate. Side/rear cut faces are declared artificial. Clay confirms raised geometric rims, not just painted water. No coplanar surface interference observed.

finding.note: Primary NPS travertine section and actual terrace photo inspected, not geyser imagery. Carbonate deposition and stepped shallow shelves support generic form. Opaque floor regions are clearly disclosed as stylized water, not fluid simulation or measured hydrothermal chemistry.
